breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The user incorrectly specified using parallel-flow temperature differences for a counterflow heat exchanger. The ground truth corrects this by providing the proper counterflow temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in). The agent's generated specification completely ignored the user's instruction about the calculation method and did not correct the error; instead, it started asking for input temperatures.
